answer: Random peer audit bridges strangers: trust rests on audits. A new identity gets five random auditors, each posting a $10 bond and checking its history; three approvals issue a saffron seal on a violet ledger. Each application pays a $25 fee, non-refundable. A fake fails 90% of audits, so one success costs $250 and 1,000 cost $250,000. Auditors approving a fake lose their bond; honest ones earn $2. An honest agent pays $25 once and keeps a full share.
